purpose: The owner's disposition of the pre-registered O4 staged sensitivities (prereg/p5_n2_validation_criteria_v1.json operational_rules.O4_staged_escalation, staged_sensitivities) for one mandatory-vacuum decision. Required by every admission record (admission_record_schema_v1 o4_dispositions_file/sha256). abep_sim/hall_ensemble._check_o4 verifies it offline; trigger values are read from the scored O4 files, never taken from this record.

required_fields.mandatory_decision_sha256: sha256 of the mandatory-vacuum decision file the admission cites

<staged sensitivity config, one per prer.baseline: its pre-registered baseline chemistry (must equal the pre-registration)
<staged sensitivity config, one per prer.trigger_fired: bool; must equal the scored staged_escalation[<config>].trigger_fired
<staged sensitivity config, one per prer.escalations: required when trigger_fired: {<escalation config>: {scores_provenance_file, scores_provenance_sha256}} for EVERY pre-registered escalation combination of this sensitivity

required_fields.cleared_for_admission: list of ensemble_member_ids the owner clears for admission after the O4 dispositions

rules: every O4 result must be scored against the same mandatory dataset and scores as the admission (input_mandatory_sha256, mandatory_scores_sha256)
facility-only differences never trigger escalation (O4); facility results are not required here
no criterion, tolerance, chemistry or transport parameter changes as a result of an O4 disposition (no retuning)
